# Wait, Noodles and Company Caters That?


Planning for events can be very overwhelming. After handling the invitations, finding a location and finalizing the guest list, the last thing you want to have to do is find a food option that everyone will enjoy, much less accommodate their needs. Luckily, Noodles & Company is here to help with just that! From individual pasta pans for smaller occasions to options that can feed a small army of noodle lovers, we’ve got the catering packages to satisfy every craving for everyone in your crew. Whether it’s a wedding, bachelorette, late night bite, grad party, birthday party, Friendsgiving, or the big game, we got you!


### Sports Watching Parties


Rather than chaotically planning and cooking all weekend long for your sports viewing party, let Noodles take the pressure off and do the hard part for you. Plus, you can embrace a truly All-American pastime by featuring a truly All-American food:[Mac Bar](https://www.noodles.com/menu/mac-cheese/creamy-cheddar-mac-cheese%3ECreamy%20Cheddar%20Mac%20&%20Cheese%3C/a%3E.%20Whether%20you%20want%20to%20stick%20to%20a%20classic,%20customizable%20%3Ca%20href=) or enhance your spread by ordering a pan of the fan-favorite[here.](https://www.noodles.com/menu/mac-cheese/buffalo-chicken-ranch-mac-cheese%3EBuffalo%20Chicken%20Ranch%20Mac%20&%20Cheese%3C/a%3E%20that%20features%20the%20perfect%20zing,%20our%20mac%20should%20have%20a%20spot%20at%20your%20Sunday%20traditions.%3Cbr%3E%3Cbr%3EEach%20pan%20feeds%20up%20to%20eight%20guests,%20and%20these%20options%20can%20also%20be%20easily%20paired%20with%20dessert%20trays%20or%20salad%20kits%20to%20ensure%20all%20your%20bases%20are%20covered.%20Sides%20like%20cheesy%20garlic%20bread%20also%20come%20in%20handy%20to%20ensure%20that%20everyone%20leaves%20your%20party%20satisfied.%20Make%20sure%20to%20check%20out%20our%20affordable%20and%20convenient%20catering%20packages%20%3Ca%20href=)


### After-School Activities


When school is in session, we know that extracurricular activities and athletics keep students incredibly busy. After a long day of learning, these developing minds need fuel to keep them up and running for their next commitment. Noodles & Company’s menu can help by providing balanced options that appeal to all ages. Keep it simple and classic with a pan of[Buttery Parmesan Noodles](https://www.noodles.com/menu/culinary-classics/buttery-parmesan-noodles) or fuel back up with the[Spicy Korean Steak Noodles](https://www.noodles.com/menu/chef-curated-with-protein/spicy-korean-steak-noodles) for student athletes. Adjust for any sized gathering with our Feed the Few or Feed the Many packages, which feed 10 or 20 students respectively.


We also are happy to provide delivery to any location that is within our delivery radius, if the timing is just feeling a little tight. No matter the sport or activity, from soccer practice to dance rehearsal, Noodles & Company is here to aid in the midst of busy schedules.


### Graduation Parties & Teacher Appreciation


We’re not just here for your first day of school, we’ll also be here for your last. Noodles catering is an especially delicious and affordable option for grad party season. Whether you’re wrapping up kindergarten or graduating from high school, we got you covered. If you’re a teacher, we also want to support you! Look out for our spring catering deals, just in time for teacher and nurse appreciation weeks.


### Wedding Receptions & Bachelor Parties


What’s better than celebrating the love of your life over a plate of noodles? That’s right, we[also cater weddings](https://www.noodles.com/wedding-catering) ! And we don’t stop there. Whether it’s your big day and you want us for a reception dinner or late-night bite, backyard rehearsal dinner, bridal shower or for your engagement party/bachelor(ette) parties...we can do it all. Noodles is always very flexible with modifying a wedding dinner up until 7-10 days out as we know how guest counts may go up or down.


Provide your guests with approachable and delicious options that will help keep the party going long into the night. Who wants a pretentious menu anyways?! Embrace the familiar, tried and true menu from Noodles & Company for variety packed options and affordable catering for the modern-day couple. With choices such as the[Crispy Chicken Bacon Alfredo](https://www.noodles.com/menu/culinary-classics/basil-pesto-cavatappi%3EBasil%20Pesto%20Cavatappi%3C/a%3E%20and%20the%20%3Ca%20href=) , you can make your wedding one that guests will be talking about for years to come.


Worried about set-up? Our Noodles specialists will personally deliver your order and put it together, so you have one less thing to worry about. We take the stress off your special day, which is the way it should be! To get extra support, please reach out to our[catering experts.](https://www.noodles.com/form/catering-experts)


### Office Gatherings


Whether it’s the PTA meeting, staff retreat, or a holiday office party, organizations love to use Noodles for their catering. Catering to everyone’s tastes in a work environment can be hard to do. Preferences and dietary restrictions can make finding an option everyone likes a nightmare. Luckily, Noodles & Company is customizable to suit everyone’s needs. With gluten sensitive dishes like the[Pad Thai](https://www.noodles.com/menu/culinary-classics/pad-thai) , we have offerings that will work for everyone. Craving a dish that may not meet your requirements? Simply swap and remove ingredients so that they can meet your preferences.


Our catering packages come at great value as each pan feeds up to 8 people and conveniently come with plates, forks, knives, serving utensils and napkins. We do the work so you can get back to brainstorming, so don’t wait to book this service soon for your next safety week, inventory, or special event for your team!


### Birthdays


Since birthdays only happen once a year, you want to make sure they are something to remember. Whether you’re turning 5 or 50, our catering offerings are good for all ages. And isn’t it everyone’s dream to have a pasta bar at their birthday party? Make dreams come true with our Mac Bar that you can mix and match to your heart’s content. Or curate your own spread with pans of your favorite pasta along with a creaser salad. Birthdays are a special day, why choose a boring option when you have Noodles & Company here to help?


Whether you are young or young at heart, Noodles caters to everyone and loves to embrace any milestone. Consider us for your next party!


### Holiday Parties


Halloween party coming up? Friendsgiving or Thanksgiving around the corner? Or perhaps you’re going hard for New Years Eve...regardless Noodles catering is a perfect holiday party option to help you stay warm and engaged during the holiday season. Keep an eye out on our website, because we usually have a 15% holiday catering discount!


### Frequently Asked Questions


#### How far in advance should I place my catering order?


A 24-hour notice is preferred for orders larger than two catering packages, and two hours’ notice is requested for single pans. However, we know plans can change, so if you need last-minute accommodation, please reach out to the manager of your local restaurant and they will do what they can to help.


#### Is there a catering delivery fee?


Yes, the delivery fee starts at $25 and includes the set-up for your order.


#### How do the Noodles Catering orders stay fresh and hot?


We offer a Hot Hold Kit for $11.95 each when you place any catering order! This ensures that your meals stay warm and appetizing throughout your event.


#### Where can I find nutritional information for catering orders?


All catering nutritional information can be found[here](https://www.noodles.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/CTR-NTR_0826.pdf) . If you have additional questions or need further information, please do not hesitate to contact us at contactnoodles.smg.com.
